data.name: Purnika
data.gender_notes: Purnika is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'purna' which means 'full' and 'ika' meaning 'one'. Purnika is the name of the goddess Parvati who is symbolized by the full moon. It represents the fullness of life and the cycle of birth, growth, and transformation. The name Purnika carries the meaning “Full Moon” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Purnika usually hope their child will grow to embody full moon and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the divine feminine energy and the fullness of life.
data.etymology: Purnika belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Full Moon.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Purnika total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
